assumptions: These are declared access gauges, not supplier tool CAD. Shaft/handle bounds include explicit design margins, not manufacturer tolerance claims.
The full 20mm-diameter handle gauge encloses the published13x13mm bounding cross-section, and is axisymmetric for grip rotation clearance.
Reduced tip length and transition profiles are unpublished. The assumed 1.10mm hex tip and0.85mm flat tip must be measured on the selected tools before assembly approval.
Nominal tip seating and a30mm straight approach are tested. Threaded screw installation must rotate and is not represented by pushing a cylinder through a smooth bore.
Human fingers, supports, torque, tool compliance, drive rounding, supplier tolerances and thread-locking procedures are not modeled.
Passive pin-cluster axial freedom is[-0.15,0]mm for the nominal stack, not a tolerance-approved range. Full-rotation/axial envelopes are conservative material proxies, not actual extra parts.
